item.title: How do you control and monitor AI API spending?
item.description: Controlling AI API costs requires setting per-user and per-project spending limits, monitoring usage in real-time, implementing cost-aware routing, and detecting anomalies before they compound.

item.title: How much are companies spending on AI APIs in 2026?
item.description: AI API spending benchmarks for 2026: startups $500-5,000/month, mid-market $5,000-50,000/month, enterprises $50,000-500,000+/month, growing 15-25% month-over-month.
